# Community code of conduct

This project expects respectful, constructive participation, following the inclusion and accountability principles of the Contributor Covenant. This is a concise project policy, not a claim to reproduce the official covenant verbatim.

- Treat contributors and users respectfully, regardless of background or experience.
- Critique ideas and code, not people. Accept good-faith feedback.
- Do not harass, threaten, disclose private information, or post unwanted sexual content.
- Keep discussions relevant and avoid repeated disruptive behavior.

Maintainers may remove inappropriate content, restrict participation or suspend access in proportion to the behavior. Explain moderation decisions when doing so would not disclose confidential information. Participants may ask for review through an available private repository-maintainer channel.

A dedicated conduct-reporting contact has not yet been established. Do not publish private incident details in public issues; request a private channel first. Before inviting broad community participation, maintainers must designate the reporting and appeal contacts.
